review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC8282349, Post-transcriptional regulation of immune responses by ZFP36 family proteins
primary_title: IL-10-mediated Tristetraprolin Induction is part of a feedback loop that controls Macrophage STAT3 activation and cytokine production; Tristetraprolin is required for full anti-inflammatory response of murine macrophages to IL-10
decision_basis: The reviews identify ZFP36/TTP as an IL-10/STAT3-induced feedback regulator; the cited primary studies show STAT3 recruitment to the Ttp promoter and Stat3-dependent TTP induction in activated macrophages.
limitations_preserved: STAT3 promoter recruitment and IL-10-dependent TTP induction support a bounded anti-inflammatory Zfp36 gene bridge; preserve LPS/IL-10 and macrophage context and distinguish ZFP36 transcription from RNA destabilization or cytokine-protein abundance, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC3670239, Infection-induced IL-10 and JAK-STAT
primary_title: Lipopolysaccharide-mediated IL-10 transcriptional regulation requires sequential induction of type I IFNs and IL-27 in macrophages
decision_basis: The reviews describe sequential type-I-IFN/IL-27 signaling and cooperative STAT1/STAT3 control of IL10 transcription; the cited primary shows STAT1 and STAT3 recruitment to the IL10 promoter, promoter-element dependence and macrophage induction.
limitations_preserved: Promoter recruitment and mutation-sensitive induction support a bounded sequential IFN/IL-27-to-STAT1/STAT3-to-IL10 gene bridge; preserve the sequential stimulus and macrophage context and distinguish IL10 transcription from secreted IL-10 protein, receptor signaling or SCI effects, with no terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3838198, The IL-10/STAT3-mediated anti-inflammatory response; PMCID:PMC3670239, Infection-induced IL-10 and JAK-STAT
primary_title: Stat3-dependent induction of p19INK4D by IL-10 contributes to inhibition of macrophage proliferation
decision_basis: The reviews identify a STAT3-dependent IL-10 growth-control program; the cited primary shows IL-10/STAT3-dependent induction and promoter activation of the murine p19INK4D/CDKN2D gene in macrophages.
limitations_preserved: STAT3-dependent promoter activation supports a bounded IL-10-associated Cdkn2d/p19 gene bridge; preserve murine macrophage and receptor-context limits and distinguish CDKN2D transcription from protein abundance, cell-cycle phenotype, SCI effects or terminal-TF output.
